_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pharmaceutical signals

pit_profile.why: 'is a global biopharmaceutical company whose mission is to discover, develop and deliver innovative medicines that help patients prevail over serious diseases.' (Item 1A heading)

BEAR.desc: EPS -22.1%/yr (worst year FY13-FY18 ex-FY15 ex-FY17, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +-0.8%/yr (FY23 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY15 ex-FY17 ex-FY19 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22 median

BULL.desc: EPS +14.3%/yr (FY13-FY18 ex-FY15 ex-FY17 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +48.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY13-FY18 ex-FY15 ex-FY17); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: BMY (retrospective, 2024-01-19) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.15x (26.2% downside to Bear $37 / +177.4% upside to Bull $139) | Adj composite 2.35 vs market 1.48: gap +0.87 [UNDERVALUED] | -17% above the EPP floor $60 (16x FY23E $3.75) | Conservative 2-yr case: +59.2% total (+29.6%/yr) | At 13.3x FY23E the 15% hurdle price $66 sits at or below the BASE case; U.S. revenues -3.9% in Q3 2023, forward revenues +2% (FY23 revenue guide ex-FX); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
